diffs.diff: acceleration m/s^2: datasheet reading gives 0.01 per count, the part's model has 0.0625, 0.0625, 0.0625
diffs.evidence: The second reading is right that acceleration is 0.01 m/s^2 per count: BNO055 datasheet Table 3-17 'Accelerometer Unit settings' says 'm/s2 ... 1 m/s2 = 100 LSB'. The part does not contradict this. It does not model or output acceleration at all: its driver has no accelerometer read and its sim has no accel register. The three 0.0625 values the gate lists are the Euler-angle measures at 0x1A/0x1C/0x1E. The datasheet confirms those (Table 3-28 Euler angle units: 'Degrees ... 1 degree = 16 LSB', so 1/16 = 0.0625 per count). There is no wrong acceleration constant in the model to fix.
